message: Flow control outside a command list: `if $x == 1` in the preamble is never parsed as `if`/`endif`.
Flow control outside a command list: `if $x == 1` in [ResourceBodyDiffuse] is never parsed as `if`/`endif`.
Flow control outside a command list: `endif` in [ResourceBodyDiffuse] is never parsed as `if`/`endif`.
